headlines.title: Trump ‘doesn’t have a plan’ on Iran: Voters in key Pennsylvania district upset with handling of war
headlines.description: NBC News Senior National Politics Reporter Jon Allen hits the road for his Drive to Decision Day series to talk to voters in several battleground congressional districts that could determine the control of Congress. Jon Allen starts his road trip in New Jersey’s 7th congressional district and Pennsylvania’s 7th and 8th congressional districts.

headlines.title: Actress Hayden Panettiere dies at 36 as investigation continues
headlines.description: The coroner’s office completed an autopsy Monday and said there were “no signs of trauma” that would have contributed to the star’s earth. The official cause is still under investigation. NBC News’ Steve Patterson reports.

headlines.title: Childhood vaccine exemptions for personal or religious reasons hit new record, CDC finds
headlines.description: The number of parents in the U.S. choosing not to vaccinate their children rose dramatically in the last school year, according to data released Monday by the CDC.

headlines.title: Lakers controlling owner Jeanie Buss hasn’t agreed to sell share of team, lawyer says
headlines.description: Her lawyer also accused Joey and Jesse Buss of leaking “false, defamatory and pernicious ‘information.’”

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Hayden Panettiere’s ex-partner Wladimir Klitschko shares ‘profound shock’ in tribute
headlines.description: Wladimir Klitschko, the former partner of actor Hayden Panettiere said their family is “going through a time of profound shock and grief,” following her death.

headlines.title: San Diego Padres minor-league catching coordinator detained by ICE in Texas
headlines.description: San Diego Padres catching coordinator Oswaldo José Pirela was detained by immigration authorities in El Paso, Texas, and remained in custody, according to family and ICE detainee records.

headlines.title: Nick Reiner has spent some of his family money on murder defense, lawyers say
headlines.description: A trustee argues that Reiner, 32, who’s charged with killing his parents, shouldn’t have access to his trust fund.

headlines.title: Newborn with heart condition at center of surrogacy legal fight has surgery
headlines.description: Rumi was born in Texas after the surrogate refused to have an abortion. The parents, who live in California, said they respected that but wanted treatment in their home state.
